text:
incident-bot: ALERT — Paging on-call: AcmeCorp VPC gateway streaming errors (ws ping timeouts, 502/504 downstream). root_ts=4112223333
sre-amy: I'm on it, joining call. seeing spikes in connection reset rate from acme-vpc-gw, ~15% stream failures last 5m
eng-raj: I can help. Any specific dedicated pool affected? which tenant id?
sre-amy: Dedicated pool acme-dedicated-3, node set a,b,c. Errors from app-gw -> backend keepalive drop. client retries causing session storm.
platform-ops: Routing shows ~40% of new stream upgrades failing TLS handshake earlier, then fallback to http polling. Might be keepalive idle timeout mismatch.
customer-ops-jane: Customer reports UI spinner and duplicate messages. Their support ticket: ACME-2345. They flagged high severity.
support-luis: Noted, informing customer that we're investigating and may enact temporary mitigation (disable streaming).
eng-raj: Quick mitigation: scale up acme-dedicated-3 by +2 nodes and set nginx proxy keepalive 90s. Command:
```
kubectl scale deployment acme-gw --replicas=5 -n acme-vpc
kubectl exec -it svc/acme-gw -- curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/_admin/reload?keepalive=90
```
sre-amy: Applying scale now, ETA ~60s. Also enabling streaming fallback throttle to limit concurrent upgrades to 200.
incident-bot: ACTION — scaling started by sre-amy (runbook step 2).
platform-ops: Scaling finished. New pods healthy. connection reset rate decreased to 6% but still above baseline.
eng-raj: Let's temporarily route Acme traffic to spare pool acme-dedicated-spare and drain problematic nodes. Runbook:
```
redwoodctl route update --tenant acme --to acme-dedicated-spare --weight 100
redwoodctl pool drain acme-dedicated-3 --grace 30
```
sre-amy: Routing switched. Draining. Monitoring latency and error rate.
customer-ops-jane: Customer confirmed partial recovery on their end, but some long-poll sessions still hang.
platform-ops: Found client-side aggressive retry policy causing thundering herd. We can enforce server-side retry-backoff header until they patch.
sre-amy: Put guard in place: add Retry-After on 502 and cap connection attempts; also enable streaming-to-polling auto-fallback for Acme for 10m.
support-luis: Messaging customer: "We've shifted your traffic to a healthy pool and added temporary throttles; engineers are continuing remediation." :white_check_mark:
eng-raj: Long-term: propose adding TLS handshake backoff and align keepalive across appgw/backends. Opening PR for config sync.
oncall-mgr: Handoff to eng-runtime for 08:00 PST investigation. SRE remains on-call for post-mitigation monitoring.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — Impact window estimated 06:12–06:42 UTC, approx 30m; affected sessions ~1.8k (~2.3% of Acme traffic). Severity: P2 (customer streaming degraded).
sre-amy: Closing active mitigation; leaving routing to spare for 15m then we'll cut back if stable. I'll post postmortem stub.
support-luis: Thanks all, will update ticket and ops channel.
